coaching.summary: Your fleet decision hinges on the trade-off between 7-Year Total Cost of Ownership Efficiency and Regulatory Non-Compliance Penalty risk, with EV Fleet Investment offering the strongest long-term TCO upside but the highest Capital Expenditure Overrun exposure. The biggest unquantified assumption is the pace and severity of emissions regulation enforcement, which could make the Status Quo untenable within 18 months.

strengthen_items.label: Phased EV pilot option
strengthen_items.detail: A partial EV fleet rollout alongside retained diesel could reduce capital risk while testing charging infrastructure before full commitment.

strengthen_items.label: Driver transition risk
strengthen_items.detail: Outsourcing eliminates your driver workforce, creating reputational and service continuity risks not fully captured in service quality alone.

elements_considered_but_excluded: Charging infrastructure as a separate factor — subsumed into EV uncertainty drivers to keep graph lean
Phased EV pilot as a fifth option — structurally similar to EV option without a distinct intervention profile; routed to coaching

bias_signals.detail: The brief frames the decision as three discrete options without considering hybrid or staged approaches that could reduce commitment risk.
